description: Main webview capabilities for Maxx. Scoped by webview rather than by window: a window-scoped capability applies to every webview in that window, which would hand these permissions to the browser pane's remote pages too. This scoping only holds while the pane stays on a remote origin — a webview sitting on the dev-server origin counts as local and bypasses the ACL entirely, which is why browser.rs refuses to navigate the pane there.
